CREATE TABLE validator_calls(id serial, opts text[], scope oid)

CREATE FUNCTION option_validator(opts text[], scope oid) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO validator_calls(opts, scope) VALUES ($1,$2); IF $1[1] = 'reject=yes' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='rejected server options'; END IF; RETURN 1; END $$
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER validating_wrapper VALIDATOR option_validator
CREATE SERVER checked_source FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER validating_wrapper OPTIONS (z 'one', a 'two')
ALTER SERVER checked_source OPTIONS (SET z 'three', ADD b 'four')
ALTER SERVER checked_source VERSION 'skip validator'
ALTER SERVER checked_source VERSION 'rejected' OPTIONS (DROP z, DROP a, DROP b, reject 'yes')
SELECT srvversion, srvoptions FROM pg_foreign_server WHERE srvname = 'checked_source'
ALTER SERVER checked_source OPTIONS (DROP z, DROP a, DROP b)
